title: FAQ: Why can OAuth return 401 after secret rotation?
content: Long-lived workers on JavaScript SDK 4.2.0 may retain the previous client secret after rotation. SDK 4.2.1 fixes the cache defect. See doc-001 for the maintained rotation procedure.

title: How does api access token lifetime work?
content: How does api access token lifetime work?. API access tokens expire after 60 minutes. Refresh tokens can obtain a new access token without asking the user to sign in again. Check the token expiry claim and clock skew before retrying a 401 response. This short answer summarizes the documented behavior; consult the full product guide for operational details. Context: token expiry refresh 401.

title: How does okta sso configuration work?
content: How does okta sso configuration work?. Create a SAML application in Okta, copy the entity ID and ACS URL from AcmeCloud, then upload the Okta signing certificate. Assign the Okta group to the application and map email to NameID. This short answer summarizes the documented behavior; consult the full product guide for operational details. Context: okta saml sso configuration.

title: FAQ: Why can Okta admins sign in while standard users cannot?
content: Check the Okta application assignment, group claim, and AcmeCloud default role mapping. A sanitized claim sample may be needed to identify the cause. See doc-004 for the maintained troubleshooting procedure.

title: FAQ: Why does webhook signature verification fail?
content: If a receiver parses and reserializes JSON before HMAC verification, its bytes differ from the signed payload. Verify the raw request body. See doc-005 for the maintained procedure.

title: How does multiple webhook endpoints work?
content: How does multiple webhook endpoints work?. An organization can register up to ten webhook endpoints. Each endpoint has its own signing secret, event subscriptions, and retry policy. This short answer summarizes the documented behavior; consult the full product guide for operational details. Context: multiple webhook endpoints.

title: How does api rate limits work?
content: How does api rate limits work?. The standard API limit is 600 requests per minute per organization. HTTP 429 responses include Retry-After; use exponential backoff with jitter and avoid immediate retries. This short answer summarizes the documented behavior; consult the full product guide for operational details. Context: rate limit 429 retry after.

title: How does api v2 to v3 migration work?
content: How does api v2 to v3 migration work?. API v3 uses cursor pagination, renames the accounts endpoint to organizations, and requires the 2026-04 API version header. Migrate in a staging environment before changing production traffic. This short answer summarizes the documented behavior; consult the full product guide for operational details. Context: api v2 v3 migration version.

title: How does javascript sdk token refresh work?
content: How does javascript sdk token refresh work?. The JavaScript SDK refreshes access tokens automatically when a refresh token is configured. Version 4.2.0 may retain an old client secret after rotation; upgrade to 4.2.1 and restart long-lived workers. This short answer summarizes the documented behavior; consult the full product guide for operational details. Context: javascript sdk refresh token 4.2.

title: How does invoice reconciliation work?
content: How does invoice reconciliation work?. Invoices are generated on the first day of the month. Export the usage report and match organization ID and billing period against invoice line items. This short answer summarizes the documented behavior; consult the full product guide for operational details. Context: billing invoice usage.

title: How does connector synchronization work?
content: How does connector synchronization work?. The AcmeCloud connector synchronizes changed records every 15 minutes. A failed sync can be retried from the integration status page after correcting credentials. This short answer summarizes the documented behavior; consult the full product guide for operational details. Context: integration connector sync.

title: How does authentication flow version work?
content: How does authentication flow version work?. The new OAuth authentication flow was introduced in API version 2026-04. Clients on earlier versions continue to use the legacy token endpoint until migrated. This short answer summarizes the documented behavior; consult the full product guide for operational details. Context: authentication flow api version.
